# lcd.GREY

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.1.0</span></div>

Get a grey color from a dark value (0 = darker) with optional alpha opacity.

```lua
local color = lcd.GREY(value[, alpha])
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | integer | yes | dark value(0 - 255) |
| `alpha` | number | optional | alpha value(0 - 1.0) |

## Returns

color (integer)

## Examples

```lua
local TRACK  = lcd.GREY(60)          -- dark grey (0 = black)
local SUBTLE = lcd.GREY(160, 0.5)    -- light grey, 50 % transparent
```

- [widget-jet](../../examples/official/widget-jet.md)
